checks.name: coverage_dev
checks.basis: convention: below half the eligible cells the cross-section is not the universe

checks.name: ic_days_dev
checks.basis: convention: fewer than 100 usable dates makes every later number noise

checks.name: activation_dev
checks.basis: convention: a factor flat most cycles cannot be held to its own thesis

checks.name: direction_frozen
checks.basis: required: the sign is frozen on dev and never re-chosen later

checks.name: coverage_val
checks.basis: convention: require coverage in every evaluation split

checks.name: ic_days_val
checks.basis: convention: require usable dates in every evaluation split

checks.name: coverage_oot
checks.basis: convention: require coverage in every evaluation split

checks.name: ic_days_oot
checks.basis: convention: require usable dates in every evaluation split

checks.name: causality_prefix
checks.basis: required: sampled past signals agree after truncating future input rows
checks.note: 9 cutoffs; sampled check only, upstream availability still requires audit

checks.name: ic_dev
checks.basis: null p95: 100 AR(1) random signals through this same pipeline

checks.name: ic_val
checks.basis: null p95: 100 AR(1) random signals through this same pipeline

checks.name: ic_oot
checks.basis: null p95: 100 AR(1) random signals through this same pipeline

checks.name: ic_t_hac_dev
checks.basis: null p95 (HAC t of the same random signals)

checks.name: ic_win_dev
checks.basis: convention: a signed IC should be positive more often than not

checks.name: bin_monotonicity
checks.basis: convention: Spearman(bin index, per-date-then-averaged forward return); bin count follows the width of the cross-section
checks.note: val: 3 bins; 452 common dates; >=2 names/bin; >=30 dates required

checks.name: topbottom_spread_bp
checks.basis: required: the top bin must out-return the bottom bin in the frozen direction
checks.note: a positive IC with a negative spread is not a bug: IC ranks, the spread averages, so a factor can be right more often while the money sits in the fat tail it is shorting

checks.name: horizon_sign_agreement
checks.basis: convention: dev IC keeps one sign across h=[1, 3, 5]
checks.note: the effect flips sign with holding period

checks.name: accounting_complete_val
checks.basis: required: every scheduled cycle has known signal, prices and funding

checks.name: net_bp_val
checks.basis: hard veto: net of trading cost and per-settlement funding, after the frozen direction

checks.name: accounting_complete_oot
checks.basis: required: every scheduled cycle has known signal, prices and funding

checks.name: net_bp_oot
checks.basis: hard veto: net of trading cost and per-settlement funding, after the frozen direction

checks.name: breakeven_cost_bps_val
checks.basis: cost-derived: needs 2× headroom over the assumed 6.5 bp one-way

checks.name: net_bp_val_vs_null
checks.basis: null p95: a random signal's net over the same cycles

checks.name: turnover_per_cycle
checks.basis: reported, not gated: 2.0 means a full close-and-reopen every cycle
checks.note: cost drag ≈ 13.0 bp/cycle at 6.5 bp one-way

checks.name: split_sign_consistency
checks.basis: required: the frozen direction keeps its sign in every split

checks.name: yearly_sign_consistency
checks.basis: convention: at most one calendar year may disagree

checks.name: sharpe_net_val
checks.basis: null p95 (annualised on the same cycle count)

checks.name: max_abs_rank_corr_vs_baselines
checks.basis: convention: |ρ| ≥ 0.7 against any single baseline is the same bet

checks.name: residual_ic_retention
checks.basis: convention: after projecting out all five baselines, keep at least half the IC

checks.name: residual_net_bp_val
checks.basis: required: the part that is not a baseline must still pay
